question: Which Union Minister of India inaugurated the Entrepreneurship Cell and Centre of Innovation at C-DOT campus, Delhi in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ashwini Vaishnaw.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer to the question "Which Union Minister of India inaugurated the Entrepreneurship Cell and Centre of Innovation at C-DOT campus, Delhi in November 2022?" is option 3, Ashwini Vaishnaw.**
 
• **Ashwini Vaishnaw **is the current Minister of Electronics and Information Technology and Railways in India.
 
• The Entrepreneurship Cell and Centre of Innovation at the **C-DOT campus in Delhi was inaugurated by Ashwini Vaishnaw in November 2022.**
 
• The Entrepreneurship Cell and Centre of Innovation will provide a platform for startups and entrepreneurs to showcase their ideas, and also provide mentorship The initiative is a part of the government's efforts to promote innovation and entrepreneurship in the country and build a strong ecosystem for startups to thrive.
 
• Hence, the statement "The correct answer is option 3, Ashwini Vaishnaw" is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Giriraj Singh is the current Minister of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj in India.
 
• Subrahmanyam Jaishankar is the current Minister of External Affairs in India.
